scenario: LCON.2.7.1 within-platform float determinism — addition. `0.1 + 0.2` is the IEEE 754 double 0.30000000000000004, the correctly-rounded sum, every run. The inline guard `(t.a + t.b) == 0.30000000000000004` fires only if the bit pattern matches exactly; fact_count 2 (T + Hit) confirms.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    a: Float key
    b: Float mutable

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    T t where (t.a + t.b) == 0.30000000000000004
->
    emit Hit logical d: 0
